refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `SilikoSyntaxTreeNewNothing` function creates a new `SilikoSyntaxTreeNode` object representing that the end of input for a particular rule has been reached, and that further parsing should be done by another rule, such as a parent rule.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: `SilikoSyntaxTreeNewError` returns a pointer to a new empty `SilikoSyntaxTreeNode` object on success, or `NULL` if there was a memory error.
